text:
ana_partnerships: quick thread to lock down SI co-sell handoffs for the marketplace + hardware partner launch. main goals: no stalled leads, clear crediting, simple escalation. thoughts?

sam_sales: Thanks. Quick clarifying q: how do we distinguish SI-introduced vs marketplace leads programmatically? Also what's the SLA to claim?

mike_se: Suggestion: SI-introduced = partner intro email OR fastpass token. fastpass validity = 72h. Claim windows: hot (demo/POC) = 48h, warm = 72h. Add CRM fields: partner_origin, si_name, marketplace_listing_id.

jordan_ops: Ops can add an "SI_claimed" status and a webhook to push claims to SI POCs. Question: require signed MSA/LOA before claim?

ana_partnerships: LOA required only for co-billing or deals > $50k. For introductions we accept partner-intro form. Legal to review PR/marketing copy.

rachel_ps: Enablement asks: 1-pager, two outreach templates (partner-intro vs marketplace), and an "SI-enabled" badge for the listing. I'll draft badge copy and a 3-min demo script.

sam_sales: Can we get a tiny routing decision table so AMs don't guess?

mike_se: dropping compact logic: if(fastpass_valid) -> route=si-immediate (claim=72h); else if(partner_score>=70 && tier==enterprise) -> route=si-priority (48h); else if(hw_tag && tier!=small) -> route=hw-si-first (48h); else -> route=hosted-first (72h).

jordan_ops: sample webhook payload we'll POST to registered SI endpoints when claim created: {"lead_id":"L-2024-11","account":"AcmeCo","route":"si-priority","claimed_by":"AtlasSI-rep","claim_window_hours":48}

ana_partnerships: nice. Ops + legal + enablement next actions: sam compile partner overrides/crediting; mike finalize routing table; rachel draft assets; jordan prototype webhook in staging. I'll schedule a 30-min sync Mon 10am PT to walk the playbook. Please add exceptions here. :thumbsup:
